overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair may limit public participation, and the complainant missed only about five minutes of an otherwise accessible meeting. A non-binding recommendation to announce reconvening was made.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board did not let her ask questions during the August 2 open session meeting.
allegations.key_passage: As it is within the chair's discretion to limit public participation during a meeting, he did not violate the Open Meeting Law by doing so here.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged part of the August 2 meeting was inaccessible because the Board made no public announcement when it reconvened in open session after executive session.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the complainant missed approximately five minutes of an otherwise accessible meeting.
